findings.evidence: The classifier at lines 81–83 depends only on `current != fkb`, so it includes old-FKB = new-LKG. Lines 103–105 then de-pin regardless of `steps.bump.outputs.updated`; `scripts/check-bump.sh:151–154` rejects any manifest change when `ML_REV_B = ML_REV_P`, including the required `inputRev` change.
findings.fix: First extend bump-guard to permit the exact-SHA-to-`master` nomination change with an unchanged resolved revision (while requiring every other manifest field unchanged), or otherwise implement a validated same-revision de-pin transition.
findings.issue: The transition unconditionally de-pins `inputRev` even when `bump-to-latest` leaves the resolved Mathlib SHA unchanged; that PR is rejected by bump-guard, so the next incompatibility repair never opens.

summary: The transition fails when the new report’s last-known-good commit equals the currently pinned old first-known-bad commit, a natural consecutive-cycle case.
